text: The Tribunals Nominating Panel must recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal following the withdrawal of one candidate who is currently being recommended for appointment.

The Tribunals Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following two candidates to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal, for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018, and until successors are appointed: - Anu Bakshi - Victoria Romero
